beallitasok.nem_elerheto: Settings are not available right now. Reconnect or reopen the workspace.
beallitasok.utkozes: Settings changed elsewhere. Reload before saving; your draft has not replaced those changes.
beallitasok.foglalt_billentyu: This shortcut is reserved by the app.
A gyorsbillentyű már foglalt: {nev}: This shortcut is already used by {nev}.
beallitasok.nyelv_leiras: The editor detects the language of each note automatically. This optional hint only guides templates and generated content. The interface stays in English.
beallitasok.frissites_leiras: App updates are managed through the installed app. Model installation and update controls are planned for later releases.
beallitasok.fajlok_leiras: Paths are relative to this workspace. Leave a folder empty for the workspace root. Use . for new notes or attachments beside the current note, and ./Assets for attachments in a subfolder there. Existing notes and folders are not moved.
beallitasok.napi_leiras: Use date tokens such as YYYY-MM-DD. Put literal folder names in brackets, for example [Daily]/YYYY-MM-DD. The .md extension is added automatically.
beallitasok.link_leiras: Applies to links inserted from now on, such as link suggestions, dragged attachments and the Link button. When Wikilinks is off, links are written as [text](path.md). Existing links keep their style when a note is renamed.
beallitasok.kuka_leiras: Deleted files go to the system Trash. Existing exclusion rules are preserved.
beallitasok.akcentus: Burgundy is the app accent. Errors and unsaved changes remain visible in quiet mode.
beallitasok.modul_leiras: Turning a module off hides its commands and tools. Your notes and module data stay in the workspace.
beallitasok.billentyu_leiras: Focus a shortcut field and press the new combination. Use Backspace to remove it. Reset restores the original shortcut.
beallitasok.modosito_kell: Include Command, Control or Option in the shortcut.
beallitasok.ments_elobb: Save or discard your settings changes before opening another screen.
beallitasok.naptar_leiras: This toggle does not request system permission. Access is requested only with the button above or the calendar command.
beallitasok.community: Community edition — all current features are available.
beallitasok.architektura: Native macOS app · local engine · Markdown workspace. Workspace identifier:
beallitasok.meglevo_leiras: Use the existing system controls for this area. Dedicated management screens will arrive in later phases.
beallitasok.modellek_leiras: Model download and calibration workflows are not part of this release. Existing local model status and controls remain available.
beallitasok.mentes_leiras: Existing backup status and destinations are available in the system overview. A destination must be configured before a backup can run.
beallitasok.ujranyitas: Reopen this workspace to apply the reported path changes.
beallitasok.modul_vissza: Your file and its data are preserved. Enable the module in Settings to open it again.
beallitasok.elozmeny_leiras: Open a note, then use its History panel to inspect snapshots and restore a previous version. Original versions remain available.
beallitasok.mentesi_hiba: The setting could not be saved. Try again after the current operation finishes.
beallitasok.hibas_tab: Tab size must be a whole number between 1 and 8.
beallitasok.hibas_betumeret: Editor font size must be a whole number between 12 and 28.
beallitasok.kulso_kep_leiras: External images in notes are never loaded automatically. An image is downloaded only when you click Download image on it; Manifold fetches it over https, checks its size and type, and saves it to your attachment folder. Replacing the web link in the note is a separate, explicit choice.
